parameters.name: MFADeviceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the MFA device.

You can call the [ListMFADevicesForUser](~~333531~~) operation to query the IDs of MFA devices.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudsso delete-mfa-device-for-user --user-id u-00q8wbq42wiltcrk0000 --mfa-device-id mfa-00ujhet8pycljj7j0000 --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --region cn-hangzhou
